about: Multi-box serving plans (src/model.js pipelinePlan, pipelineRoof, pipelineLandscape; node report.js --multibox). One model split by layers over cards on several boxes (llama.cpp RPC: the client holds the last stage, every other box runs an rpc-server; lab notes README engine verdict, an agent 2026-11-11 08:45Z), each stage priced with its card's measured llama.cpp decode line (data.bench.gpu by backend: bytes / rate + the per-step intercept + a per-MoE-layer cost), every remote stage paying one blocking round trip a step at its payload (data/interconnects.json hop_rtt), and the batch landscape run through the agent duty cycle (agentLandscape). A plan is refused when a stage's memory passes its card or a hop has no measured round trip in data/interconnects.json. Every number carries {v, tag, src}.

card_curves.about: Per-card batched decode step by kernel class (src/model.js cardStage, used by pipelineRoof): the step of a stage at B tokens is the card's host intercept x its layer share + the model's graph overhead x its layers + its dense weights (trunk share + head) + its routed experts + every stream's KV and state, each class priced by the kernel the backend runs at that B (kernels, TRACED). Mat-vec (B <= mv_max): the weights are read once and every column pays its ALU work, max(W / R, B x W x col). Past mv_max: SYCL dequantizes to f16 and runs a GEMM (W + 4 bytes a parameter of traffic: DERIVED, no constant), CUDA runs MMQ (W x mmq a GB), Vulkan mul_mm (no constant: UNCALIBRATED). MoE: B x k mat-vec columns over their experts while B <= moe_mv_max, else the distinct experts E(1 - (1 - k/E)^B) through the batched kernel (SYCL grouped dequant GEMM: grp a GB; CUDA MMQ). Every constant is solved from ONE named calibration point below (cardCurveFit, in list order: later anchors use the constants earlier ones solved); every other point is a hold-out, scored by cardCurveRescore and node report.js --cardcurve.

kernels.src: TRACED llama.cpp f3b407ca1bfe: SYCL MMVQ_MAX_BATCH_SIZE 8 (ggml-sycl/common.hpp:238, can_use_mul_mat_vec_q ggml-sycl.cpp:5172), ggml_sycl_supports_mmq returns false (4385) so a wider quantized mat-mul runs ggml_sycl_op_mul_mat_sycl (dequantize to f16 + GEMM; INFERRED, CL 60, that the reorder XMX batch kernel can_use_xmx_batch does not take UD-Q4_K_XL's mixed types: the S2 B 16 cliff is that path), the MoE mat-vec only at one token (ggml_sycl_mul_mat_id_mmvq_eligible 5636: ne12 == 1, ids->ne[1] == 1), every wider MoE step the grouped dequant GEMM over the routed experts (ggml_sycl_grouped_dequant_gemm_device, fused-gemm.cpp:1420); CUDA MMVQ_MAX_BATCH_SIZE 8 (mmvq.cuh:3), MUL_MAT_ID mat-vec up to get_mmvq_mmid_max_batch (8 on Turing for Q4_K/Q5_K/Q6_K, 5 on Pascal for Q4_K/Q5_K: mmvq.cu), then MMQ over the routed experts (ggml-cuda.cu ggml_cuda_mul_mat_id); Vulkan mul_mat_vec_id while ids->ne[1] <= 8 (ggml-vulkan.cpp:8089), dense mat-vec up to mul_mat_vec_max_cols (INFERRED 8), then mul_mm

units.col: ms a GB of weights a column (mat-vec ALU)
units.mmq: ms a GB (CUDA MMQ at B <= its tile)
units.grp: ms a GB of distinct experts (SYCL grouped dequant GEMM)
units.rate: GB/s (the B 1 read when no own line was measured)
units.overhead: ms a layer a step (the model graph's launches beyond the line's intercept)

agent_points.about: The R8 agent points (XeStrata GSQ IQ3_XXS on odie 2x B70, trace agent-long-16, 600 s warm-up + 600 s window) rescored by agentPointRescore with the frozen records' own inputs: the synthetic decode curve (MEASURED on image 06103b88: B 1 / 16 / 32 = 68.8 / 271.04 / 356.1, the named calibration data of every R8 record, never refitted), the prefill rate, the slots; the no-door points with the engine's admission, the shared prefix and the two slot groups the door records declared. The no-refit arm (predicted) calibrates nothing: every point is a hold-out there. The step-increment arm (scaled) solves ONE factor, decode_step_increment lambda, on ONE named point (calibration below: no-door B 8); that point reproduces itself by construction and is scored as use calibrates, never as a hold-out, and every other point is its hold-out. measured.useful_tps counts only turns that ended by the window end (measured.turn_counted_if; correction below). evict_branch_useful = the evict branch's rescore (docs/multibox-plan.md at ce47d16; the door rows = the frozen door records). The conv-door-live points (kind door32_lane: the served door, admission door with the lane's 60 s idle release) have no evict-branch value (null).

calibration.why: the first sweep point past one agent. The synthetic curve was measured on image 06103b88 at shallow depth; its one-agent point matches the served one (68.8 vs 70.6 MEASURED), so one factor on the batched part of its step stands for the served build and depth until the served curve is measured

correction.what: Every R8 point's measured useful_tps was recounted to the turns that ended inside the window; the as-reported number stays in measured.as_reported and is never used. lambda was re-solved on the recounted no-door B 8 (57.54, was 61.03) and every hold-out rescored. The conv-door-live points (two through the served lane door, one client-door repeat) are new hold-outs.
correction.cause: the replay counted turns that ended after the window closed: R8 answers Connection: close, so http.client drops the socket after getresponse(), Run.cut() cannot shut a running stream, the 5 s joins per thread let it finish, and report() counted any turn with an end and no error (TRACED, homelab conv-door-live f3701cabc59, agent-replay.py per_turn/report)
correction.guard: agentPointRescore marks a point whose measured block lacks turn_counted_if: ended_by_window_end as UNVERIFIED-COUNT, and a lambda solved on such a point carries count UNVERIFIED-COUNT (report.js --cardcurve prints it)
correction.not_recounted: b_eff, F_server, stall_pct and prefill_busy_pct come from server /metrics deltas and client stalls, not the turn count; the after-snapshot was read after the joins, so the no-door and r8-admission server deltas include up to the late turns' post-window work (INFERRED, not recounted)
